value.text: Dashboard serializes request.body as a whole and sends POST to ${placesUrl}/places. PLACES_URL overrides the base; its source fallback and selected Compose value are http://places:8080, giving POST http://places:8080/places. The handler has no named cityId validation. Fetch, response JSON or the 10-second timeout can reach 503 PLACES_UNAVAILABLE; that does not prove rollback or a safe retry.
